decisions.reason: The black-finish range fits the firm's design-led core offer, gained more website prominence in 2024 with a page of its own, and in a growing industry it appears to meet aspirations, giving no reason to start searching for alternatives.

The shower channel for seamless coverings has been featured on its own page in both years and matches the trend toward barrier-free bathroom architecture, which signals satisfactory results the firm can easily carry.

Although the earlier pump-assisted line C was withdrawn, the newer pump-drain channel F appears to be its refined successor with its own page, and the firm's growth and capacity investments give it the slack to carry this still-uncertain product a while longer.
